root_cause: The GitHub whole-slate backup archive was scheduled at 20:00 UTC (16:00 EDT), after ordinary early MLB games had begun. Its output could therefore be post-start even when the job succeeded.

repair.role: early whole-slate backup only; AWS per-game T-4 collection remains the primary prospective receipt path
repair.fail_closed_boundary: run_slate.py refuses a whole-slate archive when any scheduled game has reached first pitch

today_2026_07_23.interpretation: Every planned game side has an explicit terminal T-4 record. No lineup was invented when the official source had none. This is input-integrity evidence, not model-performance evidence.

next_measured_limiter: A timestamped projected-lineup source must pass its own point-in-time, identity, and raw-receipt contract before batter feature snapshots can exist at T-4 when official lineups are not yet published.
